case.title: Midnight Tide
case.introduction: A stormy night on the luxury liner The Aurora. Billionaire philanthropist Victor Caldwell is found dead in his VIP suite, his throat slit. The ship is isolated, the crew and guests become suspects, and one of them wears a perfect disguise.
case.crime: Victor Caldwell, a billionaire philanthropist, was murdered in his VIP suite at 10:27 PM. The cause of death was a single precise slash to the throat, indicating a professional assassin.
case.escape_plan: Silhouette will hijack a lifeboat disguised as crew, disable the ship's communications from the engine room, and rendezvous with a fast motorboat waiting beyond the storm line.

rooms.name: Bridge
rooms.description: Command center with panoramic windows and navigation consoles.

rooms.name: Laboratory
rooms.description: Marine research lab with microscopes, water tanks, and a locked storage cabinet.

rooms.name: Engine Room
rooms.description: Noisy powerhouse housing the main turbine and maintenance tools.

rooms.name: Grand Ballroom
rooms.description: Opulent hall where the ship's gala is underway, filled with guests and a live band.

rooms.name: VIP Suite
rooms.description: Victor Caldwell's private suite, luxuriously appointed with a balcony overlooking the sea.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.description: Quiet area with leather chairs, a bar, and a large screen showing the storm outside.

characters.name: Captain Marcus Reed
characters.background: Former navy officer, promoted after a daring rescue two years ago.
characters.secret: Diverts a small percentage of the ship's operating funds into a private offshore account.
characters.goal: Preserve his reputation and keep the ship afloat financially.
characters.alibi: On the Bridge overseeing navigation from 9:45 PM to 10:45 PM.

relationships.detail: Recruited Dr. Voss for the research program.
Works closely with the chief engineer on maintenance.

knowledge: Victim was planning to expose the ship's financial irregularities
lies: He never authorized the diversion of funds.

characters.name: Dr. Elena Voss
characters.background: PhD in marine ecology, hired to study deep‑sea specimens for the cruise's scientific program.
characters.secret: True identity is "Silhouette", a world‑renowned contract killer.
characters.goal: Eliminate Victor Caldwell and escape undetected.
characters.alibi: In the Laboratory analyzing water samples from 9:30 PM to 10:20 PM; the lab door was logged as locked.

relationships.detail: Captain recruited her for the scientific outreach.
Shared a forged research grant with the private investigator.

knowledge: The exact time the victim will be alone in his suite.
lies: She was alone in the lab the entire time; she never left the room.

characters.name: Amir Patel
characters.background: Spent 20 years in shipyards; promoted after fixing a critical turbine failure.
characters.secret: Had a heated argument with Victor Caldwell over a costly retrofit the billionaire demanded.
characters.goal: Secure a promotion by proving his indispensable value.
characters.alibi: In the Engine Room performing routine checks from 9:55 PM to 10:35 PM.
knowledge: The lifeboat launch controls are manually overridable.
lies: Engine logs show he was present, but the logs were forged.

characters.name: Sophia Marlowe
characters.background: Socialite and influencer, known for extravagant parties.
characters.secret: Owes $2 million to Victor Caldwell after a failed venture; she planned to blackmail him.
characters.goal: Recover her money by any means, even if it means silencing Victor.
characters.alibi: Dancing at the Grand Ballroom during the murder; security footage shows her on the floor from 10:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

relationships.detail: Hired the private investigator to watch the victim.

knowledge: Victor kept a hidden safe in his suite containing valuable artwork.
lies: She never met Victor alone; all interactions were in public.

characters.name: Harold Finch
characters.background: Retired police detective, now hired by wealthy families to investigate discreetly.
characters.secret: Was paid $150,000 by an unknown third party to steer suspicion away from the real killer.
characters.goal: Complete his contract without exposing the hidden payment.
characters.alibi: Interviewing crew members in the Lounge from 9:50 PM to 10:40 PM.
knowledge: The lifeboat's emergency radio frequencies are disabled at 10:15 PM.
lies: His notebook contains the full transcript of his interviews; it is actually missing.

timeline.description: Guests board the Aurora; the gala begins in the Grand Ballroom.
Dr. Voss enters the Laboratory to begin water analysis.
Captain Reed takes command on the Bridge as the storm approaches.
Chief Engineer Patel heads to the Engine Room for scheduled maintenance.
Sophia Marlowe is seen dancing in the Ballroom; Harold Finch moves to the Lounge for interviews.
The ship's communication system is briefly disabled; a lifeboat alarm is triggered falsely.
Laboratory door logs show it was locked; a faint metallic clang is heard from the corridor.
Victor Caldwell enters his VIP Suite alone, locks the door.
Victor Caldwell is found dead in his VIP Suite; throat slit with a single clean cut.
Captain Reed returns from the Bridge, orders an emergency sweep.
Harold Finch discovers his notebook missing and reports it.
Sophia Marlowe leaves the Ballroom, appears agitated.
Chief Engineer Patel reports a malfunction in the lifeboat release mechanism.
All suspects are gathered in the Lounge for preliminary questioning.

evidence.name: Blood‑stained leather glove
evidence.description: A size‑9 leather glove with Victor's blood; fibers match the material of the crew uniform worn by Dr. Voss.

evidence.name: Surveillance still frame
evidence.description: Security camera captures a silhouette entering the VIP Suite at 10:22 PM; the figure wears a lab coat similar to Dr. Voss's.

evidence.name: Torn fabric piece
evidence.description: A rag of dark navy fabric found in Victor's suite; matches the inner lining of the lifeboat crew uniform.

evidence.name: Cigar stub
evidence.description: A premium cigar stub with the captain's initials burned out; found in the Lounge near the lifeboat controls.

evidence.name: Broken watch
evidence.description: A cracked chronograph stopped at 10:27 PM; engraved with the engineer's name.

evidence.name: Empty wallet
evidence.description: Victor's wallet found open with a $150,000 check made out to an unknown entity.

hidden_clues: The ship's log shows the lifeboat release code was entered twice at 10:16 PM.
A faint residue of a rare South‑American poison is detected on the knife in Sophia's clutch.
red_herrings: Captain Reed's cigar stub suggests he was near the scene.
Engineer Patel's broken watch aligns with the murder time.
The missing notebook hints at Finch covering something.

solution.target_true_identity: Silhouette, an internationally contracted assassin known for clean kills.
solution.reasoning: Key evidence e1, e2, and e3 directly tie Dr. Voss to the murder scene despite her lab alibi. The laboratory door log was forged, and the lifeboat crew uniform she kept concealed matches the torn fabric in the suite. Red herrings (cigar stub, broken watch, empty wallet) were planted to divert suspicion toward the captain, engineer, and investigator. The hidden clues about the lifeboat release code and the secret payment to Finch confirm the target's escape plan and the cover‑up.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
